# Grade or Raw

> Grade or Raw is a free, independent service that tells Pokémon TCG collectors whether a card is worth grading (mainly with PSA) or should stay raw. It compares the expected value of grading, after fees and shipping, with the raw price, shows the math, and often concludes "keep raw". It is opinion only, not financial or investment advice, guarantees no grade or price, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, The Pokémon Company, PSA, CGC or Beckett. X account: https://x.com/GradeOrRaw

## How a verdict is calculated

- Prices are medians of the last 5 to 10 sold listings (not asking prices) for the raw card, PSA 9 and PSA 10. Fewer than 5 sales is flagged low confidence.
- Grade odds start from the card's PSA gem rate (PSA 10 population divided by total graded), then are shaded down for visible flaws (centering, whitening, scratches). Gem rates run high because people submit their best copies.
- Expected graded value = P(PSA 10) x PSA 10 price + P(PSA 9) x PSA 9 price + P(8 or lower) x PSA 8-or-lower price (raw price if no PSA 8 sales).
- Gain = expected graded value - grading fee - shipping and insurance (both ways, return shipping split across the order) - raw price.
- Verdict: "Grade" only if gain is at least $25 AND at least 20% of the raw price. Gain above $0 but below that bar is "Borderline" (grade only for your own collection). Gain of $0 or less is "Keep raw".
- Verdicts are based only on current sold prices, grade odds, grading fees and shipping on the date checked. They make no prediction about future prices.

## Fees (as of 2026-10-25, always check the source)

- PSA Standard: $59.99 per card (max declared value $1,000), the cheapest open PSA tier on that date; PSA Value tiers were paused. Source: https://www.psacard.com/services/tradingcardgrading
- PSA domestic return shipping and insurance from $19.99 per order (1-4 cards). Source: https://www.psacard.com/info/postage
- The calculator treats fees as editable inputs because they change often.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gradeorraw.github.io/Gradeorraw/): what Grade or Raw is and why most cards should stay raw
- [Calculator](https://gradeorraw.github.io/Gradeorraw/calculator.html): free in-browser grade-or-raw expected value calculator
- [Verdicts](https://gradeorraw.github.io/Gradeorraw/verdicts.html): published verdicts with their numbers; raw data at https://gradeorraw.github.io/Gradeorraw/verdicts.json
- [Methodology](https://gradeorraw.github.io/Gradeorraw/methodology.html): full method, inputs, verdict rule and fee table
- [FAQ](https://gradeorraw.github.io/Gradeorraw/faq.html): common questions
- [About and disclosure](https://gradeorraw.github.io/Gradeorraw/about.html): who runs it, support, summary of policies
- [Terms of use](https://gradeorraw.github.io/Gradeorraw/terms.html): opinions only, no guarantees, no warranties, limitation of liability
- [Privacy](https://gradeorraw.github.io/Gradeorraw/privacy.html): no data collection, no cookies, hosting and linked sites
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://gradeorraw.github.io/Gradeorraw/disclosure.html): paid links and how they are labeled
- [Trademarks and not affiliated](https://gradeorraw.github.io/Gradeorraw/trademarks.html): trademark notice

## Disclosure

Some links on the site and in posts are paid affiliate links (for example eBay Partner Network or TCGplayer); Grade or Raw may earn a commission at no extra cost to the buyer. Paid links are labeled "paid link" where they appear; posts on X with paid links use X's Paid partnership label and say so in the text. Commissions do not change verdicts. Full disclosure: https://gradeorraw.github.io/Gradeorraw/disclosure.html
